usedFor: Shopify spots the abandoned checkout and Mitto sends the text, so “Abandoned Checkout” can feed “Send an SMS”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Send an SMS” in Mitto
bestTemplate.why: It reaches the shopper by text while the cart is still on their mind.

watchOut: An SMS to a customer waits for your approval, and “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so it is not instant.
